Police Officer Attacked by Pet Dog in Patna : daroga par paltu kutte ka hamla, malik par laga aarop!
In a shocking incident from Patna, Bihar, a police officer was allegedly attacked by a landowner’s pet dog while enforcing a court order. Sub-Inspector (Daroga) Vikas Kumar Singh of Buddha Colony Police Station visited the Uttari Mandiri area near Navin Sinha Path (Sudha Booth) to stop ongoing construction on a disputed plot. The court had already issued a stay order prohibiting any construction on the land.
